author: savecalifornia

item.authorHandle: savecalifornia
item.caption:
It’s a long ballot, but we’ve got you covered. Vote informed! And challenge your friends and followers to vote by sharing this post 👊🇺🇸

Just take out your ballot, and fill it in while you visit our California Pro-Family Election Center at SaveCalifornia.com. 👉 Tap link 🔗 in bio @savecalifornia
 
Your vote for conservative and moral + social + fiscal values is needed! 

Everyone needs to vote who hasn’t yet voted.

⚠️ As of Friday, Oct. 30 at 7:30pm, only 26% of California’s registered Republican voters had returned their ballots. 

(See PDI’s returned ballot tracker: https://tracker.politicaldata.com/?type=statewide)
 
🧐 From Noah Webster (1758-1843), author of the 1828 American Dictionary of the English Language 👇👇👇

If the citizens neglect their duty and place unprincipled men in office, the government will soon be corrupted . . . . If a republican government fails to secure public prosperity and happiness, it must be because the citizens neglect the Divine commands, and elect bad men to make and administer the laws.

#letsgo #california #yourvoicematters #ivoted #savecalifornia
